title: Exporting at 2x draws the text sharp instead of blowing the picture up
goal: Exporting a redline at 2x makes a bigger file but not a sharper one: the app finishes the picture at the document size and then enlarges it, so the words come out just as soft as they were. A 2x export should have letters with hard edges.
notes: DocumentRenderer.render(_:store:scale:) still composites at 1x and applies CILanczosScaleTransform. The machinery to do it properly landed on 2026-09-04: composite document.magnified(by: scale) with contentScale: scale, the way renderTile does. Left out of that task because it changes the pixels every existing export test pins.
acceptance: A label exported at 2x has visibly sharper edges than the same label exported at 1x and scaled up
Exporting at 1x produces exactly the pixels it does today
Export timing for a 12 megapixel document does not get worse
